bounded_conclusions: Overlay 7 constructs a dedicated 496-byte throw controller and publishes it through the battle session before shot and landing evaluation.
The controller is evaluated by a primary routine at 0x02259AF0 and, only when that routine returns false, an alternate routine at 0x0225A278.

Controller byte +0x1D2 is initialized to zero, receives executable values 0 through 4, is read immediately before arena attachment, and produced runtime values 1, 2, and 3 at valid execution boundaries.
A controlled natural throw confirmed +0x1D2 value 1 as the player-facing GATE CARD WON! result.
Controller byte +0x1DF selects three alternate attachment classes through value 5, value 6, or all other values, but the writer and player-facing meaning of this byte are not yet mapped.
Controller byte +0x1E8 stores the one-based descriptor index returned by 0x02262768 after attachment and is therefore separated from landing result or shot-condition semantics.

evaluation_paths.name: primary landing evaluator
observations: Requires controller phase byte +0x1E0 to equal 3 before continuing.
Projects controller position data into two temporary grid bytes through 0x02248998.
Writes controller +0x1D2 with values 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 according to participant and descriptor comparisons.
Reads +0x1D2 and participant-association bytes immediately before calls to 0x02262768.
Stores the one-based attachment result at controller +0x1E8.

evaluation_paths.name: alternate landing evaluator
observations: Runs only when the primary evaluator returns false through dispatcher 0x02255640.
Reads controller +0x1DF and maps value 5, value 6, and all other values to attachment classes 2, 3, and 1.
Stores the one-based attachment result at controller +0x1E8.

fields.evidence: Constructor 0x02252730 initializes the byte to 0. The primary evaluator writes immediate values 1, 2, 3, and 4 and also copies a branch result into it; the alternate evaluator writes values 1, 2, and 3. The byte is read before arena attachment. A controlled natural throw reached 0x02257AC8 with the prior byte equal to 0, stored value 1, resumed normally, and displayed GATE CARD WON!.

0x0225A670 compares the byte with 5 and 6. Those branches pass attachment classes 2 and 3 to 0x02262768; every other value passes class 1. The authoritative writer, full value domain, and gameplay labels are not yet mapped.

Constructor 0x02252730 stores its fourth argument at +0x1D3. Both evaluators pass this byte to arena attachment. Runtime captures observed values 1 and 2, but the canonical participant mapping is not yet proven.

Constructor 0x02252730 stores its third argument at +0x1D4 and derives +0x1D5 from the selected participant object's +0xF2 byte. The primary evaluator compares descriptor participant identity against both bytes; attachment calls pass +0x1D4. Exact active-versus-teammate labels require a controlled participant reversal.

Every primary and alternate attachment path stores the return value of 0x02262768 at +0x1E8. The shared helper allocates an arena descriptor and returns its one-based index. This field is explicitly excluded as the landing result or shot condition.

rejected_or_separated.reason: They identify the active Gate and owner after battle construction but do not preserve the preceding throw or landing classification.

runtime_anchors.selected_evidence: The 496-byte object was allocated through the sole constructor call at 0x0226BDAC and published at session +0x298. Raw debugger packets and memory were not committed.
Valid session 0x0229FC80 and controller geometry were present; controller +0x1D2 was 3 and participant-association bytes +0x1D3/+0x1D4/+0x1D5 were 1/0/0 before attachment.
A later valid stop observed controller +0x1D2 as 2 and participant-association bytes +0x1D3/+0x1D4/+0x1D5 as 1/1/1 before attachment.

runtime_anchors.selected_evidence: Controller +0x1D2 was zero immediately before value 1 was stored. Execution resumed normally and displayed GATE CARD WON!. Raw debugger packets and the screenshot were not committed.
